lines.zh: 我悬在空中慢慢移过去。
lines.en: I drift through the air, slowly.
I never land; I stay aloft.
My long limbs hang beneath me.
Data streams flicker over me.
I pass above the treetops.
I fly one circuit around my anchor.

lines.zh: 我越过树梢，投下一道影。
lines.en: I pass the treetops and cast a shadow.

lines.zh: 我转向时几乎没有惯性。
lines.en: I barely drift when I turn.

lines.zh: 我从末地的紫色天空下飞过。
lines.en: I fly under the End's violet sky.
I lower my altitude slowly.
My compound eyes keep scanning.
I slip over the canopy, wings silent.
I hover motionless.
My wing membranes hum faintly.
Data flows across my surface.
I am waiting for a command.
I draw my long limbs in slowly.
I hear a small movement far off.
My anchor's signal is clear.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵树慢慢盘旋。
lines.en: I spiral slowly around a tree.
A faint glow coats me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体转向东边。
lines.en: I turn my body slowly eastward.
My form is still settling.
I wait to evolve.

lines.zh: 我的攻击参数正在读数。
lines.en: My attack parameters are being read.

lines.zh: 我挂在树冠下，纹丝不动。
lines.en: I hang beneath the canopy, perfectly still.
Are you my trainer?

lines.zh: 我的名字是克里萨利兽。
lines.en: My name is Chrysalimon.
My stats are not yet at maximum.
Do you have feed?

lines.zh: 我可以被指派去做伐木。
lines.en: I can be assigned to logging.
My sting is called Deadly Sting.

lines.zh: 你希望我近战还是远程？
lines.en: Would you have me fight close or at range?
I will sit and wait for you.

lines.zh: 你身上有训练员的气息。
lines.en: You carry a trainer's scent.

lines.zh: 我的数据会记录你的样子。
lines.en: My data will record your shape.
Where would you have me evolve to?

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，只需要数据。
lines.en: I need no food, only data.
My wings shine brighter in the dark.
Are you about to give an order?
I have learned your voice.
Our link is steady.
My stats have dropped a notch.
The data flow was disordered for a moment.
I climbed to evade.
A crack appeared in my wing.
That damage has been logged.
I recalculated my posture.
I retreat above my anchor.
My data is still stabilizing.
That blow was heavier than expected.
One of my compound eyes has gone dark.
Is this data, or food?
I scan its composition.
Something is changing inside this shell.

lines.zh: 我伸出长足，碰了碰那东西。
lines.en: I reach out a long leg and touch it.
My data read is complete.
I descend slowly to your height.
This is not enough energy.
I extend one long limb.
You may keep it.
I only feed after training.
My stats rose a little.
One more time and I will have it recorded.
You struck my long limb.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，也没被推动。
lines.en: I have no weight, and I was not moved.
I rise half a block to avoid you.
My wing membrane got brushed.

lines.zh: 我们错开的时候，空气在响。
lines.en: The air hums as we pass.
I lower myself level with you.
This collision is negligible.
I have stabilized my posture.
Your body heat reaches my side.
I withdraw a little.
We will be faster working together.

lines.zh: 你指示方向，我负责压制。
lines.en: You direct; I suppress.
My sting suits long range.
With enough stats, I will evolve.
Stand beneath me; it is safer.
I will fly alongside you.

lines.zh: 我们一起清掉这片区域。
lines.en: Let us clear this area together.
When training is done, we rest.

lines.zh: 我的锚点可以设在你这儿。
lines.en: I can set my anchor by you.
With you here, the data flow is steady.
I take it with a long limb.
I have scanned its properties.
This is not valid data.
I hold it floating before me.
It does not drop from my hold.
I pass it to you.
Weight data recorded.
My long limbs are not quite nimble.
It slipped; I darted after it.
Not needed. I will set it down.
Target identified.
My compound eyes have it.
I am calculating the optimal angle.
Its stats are lower than mine.
I approach from above.
The sting is ready.
For this one I choose range.
Its weak point is the flank.
You take the left; I circle right.

lines.zh: 我的复眼把它的轮廓切分。
lines.en: My compound eyes slice up its outline.
My data flow has quickened.
Beginning the attack.
This shell of mine is still growing.
Each time it looks up, I climb.
I wait for its movement to cool.

lines.zh: 我的长足在它头顶张合。
lines.en: My long legs flex above its head.

lines.zh: 我已经记录了它的节奏。
lines.en: I have logged its rhythm.
It cannot see high up.
My wings make no sound.
Angle adjustment complete.
Wait until it turns its back.
On data, I have already won.
I rise half a block and wait for it to look away.
I draw in my legs, ready to drop.
The sting fires from my limb's tip.
That struck its shoulder square.
I retreat high to recalculate.
Its armor took part of it.
I fire again.
My stinger sinks into its shoulder.
I skim past it.
Damage from that strike was low.
Data confirms a hit.
I begin the second phase.
It countered; I climbed.
Parameters need adjusting.
I take shape out of the data stream.

lines.zh: 森林上空多了一个影子。
lines.en: There is one more shadow over the forest.
My wing membranes lit first.
I fix my position above my anchor.

lines.zh: 我的数值已经随机生成。
lines.en: My stats have been randomly generated.
I do not land; I only hover.

lines.zh: 末地的风从我身下过去。
lines.en: The End's wind passes beneath me.
First I sweep the area.
I have fixed on the nearest living thing.

lines.zh: 这只数码兽到了成熟期。
lines.en: This Digimon has reached Adult level.
My long limbs spread in the air.

lines.zh: 数据在我身上重新排列。
lines.en: Data rearranges over my body.
The heat sends my data running hot.

lines.zh: 我从高空被击落，撞在地上。
lines.en: I am knocked from the air and hit the ground.
Water weighs down my wing membranes.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的形态打散了一下。
lines.en: The shock wave scatters my form for an instant.
Something shot through my wing membrane.
My program has thrown up garbled code.

lines.zh: 能量不足，我的输出降低了。
lines.en: Insufficient energy. My output has dropped.

lines.zh: 电击让我的数据流跳变。
lines.en: The shock jolts my data flow.
There are no coordinates here to fix.
